third_party_evaluations.summary: Advanced threat detection, EDR/XDR, deception, and automated response across the Fortinet Security Fabric.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Advanced detection, EDR/XDR and automated response across the recorded security fabric support professional operations at three years; vendor scope limits portability to other enterprise environments.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Advanced EDR/XDR detection and automated response across the Security Fabric fit professional SOC implementation. The three-year profile supports this level, but the proctored exam record does not prove expert live-response performance.

alex-novak.rationale: Advanced detection, EDR/XDR and automated response across the recorded Security Fabric scope support professional operations knowledge. The three-year profile and lack of an explicit practical exam keep it below expert.
